title: SignShield
description:
A Bypass mod for servers that use signs translations to detect client mods,
like DonutSMP
body:
# 🛡️ Sign Leak Shield
is a **client-side** Fabric mod that blocks sign-based translation exploits by detecting and filtering server sign packets and forceing fallback over translating. 

This **blocks** common mod **blacklists** on servers like _Donut SMP_

![Logo](https://dock-it.dev/repo-avatars/05080923ea22308b122e2d6aa40047c3a9d0117f025dcc4d82f369dcd3963d32)
